findings.F1: The book does not time anything; it is close to holding. The position is long on 97.4 % of bars with a mean allocation of 0.995, and 50.4 % of the long bars have a forecast of 0, because the 10-day hold carries one down day's signal across about half of all days. Of the book's mean bar gain of 0.000881, the market's own rise gives 0.001256 and timing gives -0.000386.
findings.F2: Calmar fails because the book carries the coins' bear markets. Its deepest fall is -80.6 % over 277 days, from window w12 to w14; holding fell -80.0 % at its deepest, and the coins lost -79.5 % over that same stretch. Against that fall the book's yearly return is only 4.3 %.
findings.F3: The tested effect is not in these cells, so the move per case is not an edge. The unusual 10-day move per case is -0.20 % (strength -0.013, 553 cases) against a round trip of 0.11 %, and the slope t is 1.57 over 292 cells. All of the +1.06 % total move is the coins' drift.
findings.F4: The gradient by fall size is weak and not significant. Positive-forecast cells by forecast tercile show excess 10-day returns of -1.03 % (t -0.89), +0.92 % (t 0.63) and +1.82 % (t 1.54), from smallest to largest fall, about 97 cells each.
findings.F5: The rebound after a down day looks better when the coin's 20-day return is up, but no tercile is significant. Excess is +1.38 % (t 0.98, 73 cells) in the 20-day-up tercile, against +0.09 % (t 0.05) in the down tercile and -0.30 % (t -0.21) in the middle one. Down days at a new 20-day low show -0.25 % (t -0.09, 29 cells).
findings.F6: The book's worst bars come after the coin has already been falling, and the book holds more then. Its worst 5 % of bars follow a 20-day return of -4.6 % (+2.5 % on the other bars), at an allocation of 1.29 (1.04 on the other bars).
findings.F7: The weakest market state is a middling 60-day trend. All grid cells in the second 60-day-return quartile have an excess 10-day return of -2.95 % (t -2.17, 63 cells), and the book's mean bar gain there is -0.00467. The other quartiles are not significant (t -0.15 to 0.85).
findings.F8: The record holds only BTC and ETH; BNB, named in the brief, did not run.

no_ideas: The effect the book bets on is not in the data, and no market state found here (20-day trend, distance to the high, new low, volatility, 60-day trend) carries a significant rebound that would lift the book above holding or keep it out of its -80 % falls.
